question: Distinguish randomized address order with exact round coverage from repeat visits and uneven coverage

patterns.name: random-permutation
patterns.round: Seeded Fisher-Yates shuffle of all N pages; independent deterministic permutation per round; every page exactly once

patterns.name: uniform-random-with-replacement
patterns.round: N draws over the same N pages using the pinned current fio randwrite/tausworthe64/norandommap=1 semantics; revisits allowed

preconditioning: One common history for all arms, frozen before execution after reviewing the history control; no arm-specific warmup
proposed_budget: Reuse a common 25.199981689 GiB ceiling, six 4.199996948 GiB report windows, final three assessed with the existing convergence gate; do not choose a different horizon per arm
request_path: Preferred common fio 3.36 libaio/QD1 direct replay for all three traces. Before main execution, validate replay equality with native direct S/R and hash verified offset sequences. If exact current replacement sequence cannot be preserved/verified, stop and revise the plan; do not silently swap generators.
permutation_warning: fio lfsr has no repeated offsets but is not a uniform random permutation. norandommap=0 alone does not certify the requested shuffle. Use an explicitly audited permutation, not a renamed randwrite workload.
trace_validation: Exactly N requests and N*4096 host bytes per round for every arm
All offsets aligned and inside the same region; all writes exactly 4096 bytes
Sequential and permutation: distinct address count=N, each address frequency=1, identical address multiset
Permutation: reproducible per-round seed and hash; no trace sorting by the submission layer; verify issued order at QD1
Replacement: record unique-address fraction, repeated requests, page frequency histogram and revisit gaps; expected coverage approximately 63.2% is an analytical reference, never an acceptance target
Trace-only offline checks and actual replay correctness are separate gates; both need future approval before runtime
contrasts: P minus S: randomized order at equal exact per-round coverage
R minus P: replacement/uneven coverage and associated temporal-locality bundle, not an isolated single revisit effect
P approximately S below R: replacement/coverage bundle is the stronger candidate explanation in this profile
S below P approximately R: order loss alone can explain much of the observed gap in this profile
S below P below R: both contrasts contribute; do not assign universal causal percentages
Non-convergence, unexpected ranking or byte/trace mismatch: retain all results and investigate before interpreting
analysis: Pair by seed; rates from native window deltas and ratio of sums; mean and sample SD across three runs per arm. Reuse exact frozen 1% near tolerance as a descriptive screen, not a statistical equivalence test. No treating adjacent windows as independent replicates.
safety: One small VM at a time; fresh QEMU and common deterministic history per run; same shared-server limits; project-local traces/caches/images; exclude large traces from Git
exclusions: No solution, policies, FDP, fill/OP/geometry/request-size sweep, LLM or real-device experiment

preferred_common_history_after_control.reason: Retain the archived protocol as the common candidate: the selected 1-vs-3 history control passed the descriptive near gate. This does not establish permutation convergence; freeze after user review.
